gameDescriptionHtml:
Rebuild humanity on the mysterious planet Mira – The massive sci-fi adventure returns for a new generation. Explore the planet Mira and defend yourself against enemies using giant, weaponized robots.

Earth has fallen – The year is 2054. Earth has been destroyed by an intergalactic war between two alien races, and humanity is on the brink of annihilation. A small number of survivors, aboard the USS White Whale, crash land on the vast and untamed planet Mira. Now, it falls to you, as a member of BLADE, to help bring humanity back from the edge of extinction…with the aid of powerful giant robots called Skells.

Game Features

  • Combat basic training – Choose from a huge variety of special attacks, skills, and classes in a combat system that’s as deep as you want it to be.
  • Pilot powerful Skells – Once you’ve proven yourself, you’ll earn the right to pilot and personalize your very own Skell—a powerful machine that can fly, transform into a vehicle for faster overland travel, and wield immense strength in combat with customizable weapons and armor. With three weight classes and a ton of weapon attachments to choose from, a well-tinkered Skell can give you the edge you need. Skells can run, fly, and leap to help get around the world.
  • A massive world full of surprises – Discover bizarre and beautiful plants, animals, and landscapes on your journey across planet Mira. Map new areas, collect resources, and try to locate fellow survivors as humanity builds New Los Angeles.
  • Assemble your crew – Recruit party members to your cause from a memorable cast of characters. Each companion has different combat and support skills to offer. You can customize their gear, weapons, and more at any time.
  • Squad up to work together online – Once you have enough experience, you can join an online* squad of up to 32 players to take on multiplayer missions. Squad members can recruit each other’s avatars to their parties, share information, give and receive gear or items, and team up for missions or battles.
